title: Card 1: sab App ek hi Redis ginti dekhte hain. Chhathi request pe 429

boxes.title: Redis (ginti yahin)
lines: 60 sec baad ginti khud mit jaati

callouts.red: Pehle har App apni alag ginti rakhti thi: App 1 ne 5 gine, App 2 ne 4, to 9 andar

callouts.green: Har request pe disk aur lock, bahut dheema. Redis RAM me hai, ~1 ms

callouts.red: LB se Arpan ko hamesha ek hi App pe bhejte (sticky)?
callouts.green: Wo App giri to Arpan ki ginti bhi saath gayi

callouts.red: Minute ke aakhri second me 5 aur agle minute ke pehle second me 5: 2 sec me 10 andar
callouts.green: Ye "minute wali" ginti (fixed window) ki kamzori hai. Isliye asli me token bucket lagate

kyun: Saari App ek hi jagah (Redis) ginti dekhti hain, aur Redis RAM me hai to tez. Ginti ki umar 60 sec hai: minute khatam to ginti khud mit jaati, naya minute 0 se
peeche: shuru: kai App, har App apni ginti
ab: Arpan ne 9 baar login dabaya, do App ne alag-alag gina, saare andar gaye
agla: ab ginti ek jagah hai. Par 20 request ek hi pal me aayi to? (card 2)
